run_rl_rollout: run the RL policy in test mode to produce a rollout HDF5 file from a checkpoint
render_hdf5_to_video: render a video from an HDF5 rollout file by converting to NPZ and using SPIDER record_video
convert_hdf5_to_npz: convert an RL rollout HDF5 file to NPZ format with qpos and base_state arrays
run_both_rollout_and_render: run the RL evaluation and render the resulting trajectory video in a single command
render_npz_to_mp4: render an MP4 video from an NPZ trajectory file using SPIDER's Isaac Gym simulator
